hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Santa Barbara With a Fixed Price Up Front
hero.subheadline: Owner Kiel Kellow's in-house designers and builders plan your kitchen side by side, then give you one fixed construction price before anyone breaks ground.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Santa Barbara area: Montecito kitchen with a white oak island, marble countertops, glass pendants and a skylight

intro.h2: Designers and builders at the same table
paragraphs: Kellow Construction handles kitchen remodeling in Santa Barbara and Montecito as a design-build firm, so the people drawing your kitchen work beside the people who will build it. Owner Kiel Kellow is a design-focused builder who believes estimating and design should always go hand in hand.

That belief runs the whole job. Cabinetry, countertops, tile, hardware and lighting are picked before you sign the construction contract, and the price that follows is one fixed number. A single project manager then runs the work from demo to punch list. On site, superintendent Rudy brings more than two decades of supervising local remodels.

services.h2: Design-build services across Santa Barbara and Montecito

items.name: Kitchen Design and Remodel
items.blurb: Your in-house designer works with your project manager from concept through construction, so the kitchen on paper is one the team knows it can build on budget. Layouts, finishes and details are settled early, whether the house is a historic craftsman bungalow or a modern hillside home.

image.alt: Remodeled Santa Barbara kitchen with white cabinets, a farmhouse sink, a professional range and a patterned tile backsplash under a plaster hood

items.name: Bath Design and Remodel
items.blurb: Primary suites, guest baths, small modern baths and historic restorations, plus Spanish-style tilework drawn from Santa Barbara's own architecture. Layout, plumbing, tile and fixtures are planned and priced before construction begins, so fewer surprises turn up once the walls are open.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel with a double vanity, marble top, brass faucets, freestanding tub and herringbone floor

items.name: Whole House Remodels
items.blurb: For gut renovations, phased remodels and big layout changes, the team treats the house as one system. Structural changes, systems upgrades and work across kitchens, baths, living areas and bedrooms are planned together. One client's 1888 former barn was rebuilt from roof to foundation.

image.alt: Whole-house interior renovation in Santa Barbara with exposed ceiling beams, wide windows and an open dining area

items.name: Home Additions
items.blurb: Additions are designed to feel like they were always part of the house. Kellow carries them from the first sketch through permits, construction and close-out, using the same design-build team and the same fixed-price contract it uses for every remodel.

image.alt: New framing and vaulted roof structure during a Kellow Construction remodel in Santa Barbara

why_choose_us.h2: What you get when one team designs and builds

items.title: One number before you build
items.text: Kellow works on a fixed-price, single-number construction contract. Every selection and detail is priced first, so you know exactly what you are building and what it costs before ground breaks.

items.title: Senior attention on big projects
items.text: The firm describes itself as big enough for complex, high-end projects and small enough that homeowners still get senior attention. Your designer works full time with your project manager and field crew.

items.title: Permit experience close to home
items.text: The team has worked through Santa Barbara permitting, Montecito overlay regulations and Hope Ranch project requirements across dozens of projects. That shapes the feasibility and timeline advice you get from the first conversation.

items.title: A rare green credential
items.text: Kellow says it is the only contractor in California holding the Earth Advantage Sustainable Homes Professionals designation, part of its aim to shrink both its own carbon footprint and its clients'.

about.h2: Meet owner Kiel Kellow and his crew
about.text: Kiel Kellow grew up between Tillamook County, Oregon and Bainbridge Island, Washington. He sharpened his carpentry while living aboard his 1934 wooden sailboat, working on boats, high-end custom homes and in a cabinet shop. In Portland he became a lead carpenter for an award-winning design/build firm before starting his own company. Today he leads Kellow Construction from Santa Barbara. Office manager Emily Kellow, born and raised in town, runs contracts, accounting and insurance. Project manager Jason brings more than 15 years of carpentry, and designer Tara holds a BFA in Interior Architecture.

image.alt: Kiel Kellow, owner of Kellow Construction in Santa Barbara, CA

process.h2: How your remodel moves from idea to fixed price

steps.title: Initial consultation
steps.text: A no-pressure talk about your home, goals, vision and investment range, and whether the design-build process is the right fit for both sides.

steps.title: Design phase 1
steps.text: The team studies your existing home, priorities, constraints and permit issues, and lines up scope with budget while there is still room to adjust.

steps.title: Design phase 2
steps.text: With a Design Agreement signed, in-house designers develop plans, layouts, materials, fixtures and finishes, with builders checking cost and constructability along the way.

steps.title: Documents, permits and fixed price
steps.text: Technical drawings, engineering and permits come next. Once scope and selections are defined, you get a fixed-price construction contract instead of a rough estimate.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Your project manager and site superintendent build from the plans and selections made in design, with regular updates and clear accountability until the final details.

service_area.text: Kellow Construction is locally owned and based on East Micheltorena Street in Santa Barbara. The team works in Santa Barbara, Montecito, Goleta and Carpinteria and has handled projects in Hope Ranch. Inside the city, past work and local knowledge cover the Mesa, the Riviera and the Upper East Side, where homes run from Spanish Colonial and craftsman bungalows to modern hillside builds.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Santa Barbara: your questions answered

items.q: Will I know the full price before construction starts?
items.a: Yes. Kellow does not ask you to commit to construction based on a rough estimate. Design, drawings, selections and pricing happen first. Once the scope is fully defined, you get a fixed-price, single-number construction contract, so you know exactly what is being built and what it costs before ground breaks.

items.q: Do you work on historic homes?
items.a: Yes. The team works across Santa Barbara styles, from Spanish Colonial and Santa Barbara bungalows to contemporary coastal homes, and offers historic bathroom restorations. Past clients include the owners of an 1888 former barn and a 1920s craftsman, who wanted the house updated while keeping its original character.

items.q: What if I already have an architect or designer?
items.a: Most clients have Kellow manage the design, but the firm also works with outside architects and interior designers. Its Iterative Design Process brings them into a shared loop that keeps ideas buildable and on budget. Kellow says it enjoys partnering with design pros who care about cost, quality and detail.

Yes. As the design comes together, the team prepares the technical drawings and specifications, coordinates consultants and engineering, and guides the project through permitting. It has worked through Santa Barbara's permit process and Montecito overlay regulations many times, which helps set a realistic timeline early.

items.q: Is there a warranty on the work?
items.a: Yes. Kellow offers what it calls a comprehensive warranty, so the team is still there for you long after the project is finished. The site does not list the length or terms, so ask for the written warranty during your consultation and review it before you sign the construction contract.
